model.stratum: Stationary continuous-path realization of the actual regular strongly local tilted gradient form; uniform radius-two coordinate fourth moments, countable-product path tightness, and joint source path/drift/martingale/bracket comparison using stationary based L2 recovery. No all-start-point weak drift, strong SDE uniqueness, original-to-tilted path density or physical-clock identification is inferred.
missing_constructors: actual finite-horizon original-to-tilted path density and source entropy interpretation
all-start-point weak-drift and strong SDE claims if sought
model.next_falsifier: The actual form is not regular/strongly local, coordinate moment constants lose source-volume uniformity, finite-time words are promoted without tightness, or weak drift time integrals cannot be controlled by common-field stationary L2 recovery.
